loginOptionalDesc: You can keep using Pickly without an account. Sign in only if you want your polls available on every device.
claimDescOne: We found 1 poll created on this device. Link it to your account?
claimDescMany: We found {count} polls created on this device. Link them to your account?
callbackError: We couldn't complete the sign-in. Try again.
anonModalDesc: You can keep going, but this poll will only be manageable from this device. The voting link still works normally for anyone — this is just so you, as the creator, don't lose access if you switch phone or browser.
